June 10, 2018 - By Dolores Ford
Ken Griffin decreased its stake in Churchill Downs Inc (CHDN) by 35.55% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Citadel Advisors Llc sold 56,737 shares as the company’s stock rose 18.26% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Ken Griffin held 102,855 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $25.10 million, down from 159,592 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Citadel Advisors Llc who had been investing in Churchill Downs Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $4.04 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.23% or $0.7 during the last trading session, reaching $305.35. About 58,260 shares traded.
